_comment: v3.1.x WS2 task-diversity sweep. Shared FROZEN encoder (SHA-asserted), per-task qh1 query head (stage B only, pairwise loss). Cell axis = (task, seed). Synthetic tier1 already contains all task types, so zero new data. Temporal task 2 is the existing v3.1 baseline and is NOT re-swept here; this sweeps the geometry-sensitive tasks 0(provenance) 1(entity-res) 3(multihop) 4(subgraph) 5(compound). Gate: per-task mean ndcg@10 over seeds >= baseline_mean + max(spec_delta, 1*std) using the v3.1 task-2 noise floor (lock_baseline.gate_threshold) as the reference bar. Also reports oracle_ndcg@10 (ceiling) and oracle_gap@10 (ordering headroom) so the report shows where graph geometry's margin is largest vs the locality-friendly temporal task. Frozen-encoder guarantee is SHA-assert + skip-stage-a recorded in summary config (task-invariant; the cross-task intrinsic-edge-prec equality used by the query-head sweep does NOT apply here since per-task val_ds[0] is a different graph).
